files.title: File:Morning Haze on Dana Point Marina, CA 9-16 (29703547572).jpg
files.author: Don Graham from Redlands, CA, USA - God bless it!
files.caption:
(1 in a multiple picture album)
There are always those shots you didn't get. For years I have wanted a shot of the Dana Point Marina from above. On this latest trip I found the road, appropriately named Scenic Drive, that gives me that view. But both mornings I tried the shot we had a marine layer. Well, that's part of the beach experience.
